name: Public Works Roads Department, Government of Assam
summary: The state department that builds and maintains Assam's state highways, major district roads and bridges.
about: Assam's roads department maintains a network built on the floodplain of one of the world's largest rivers. The Brahmaputra floods every year and washes away embankments, culverts and whole stretches of road, so rebuilding after the monsoon is an annual routine rather than an emergency.
facts: Responsible for Assam's state highways and major district roads.
Also looks after most state-owned bridges and government buildings.
National highways in the state are not its responsibility — those belong to NHAI, NHIDCL or the state's national highway wing.
